 A moment involving Mary Kom, Amrapali Dubey and Kushal Tanwar aka Gullu in the Bigg Boss 20 house has drawn attention after a conversation took an unexpected personal turn. While Gullu remained calm during the exchange, Amrapali's remarks brought a different dimension to the interaction.
 During the conversation, Mary Kom, apparently due to a language barrier, unknowingly addressed Gullu using a feminine form. However, Amrapali stepped into the discussion and questioned him, saying, “What are you doing, Gulli?” Her remark appeared to turn an unintentional language-related moment into a personal jibe directed at Gullu.
 --> 
 The exchange highlighted how a simple misunderstanding can take an uncomfortable turn when it becomes the subject of personal remarks. What began as an interaction involving Mary Kom soon shifted towards Gullu's personality, bringing an unnecessary personal angle into the conversation.
 Despite the comments, Gullu did not react aggressively or engage in a heated argument. Instead, he maintained his composure and chose not to retaliate, keeping the situation from escalating further.
 Life inside the Bigg Boss 20 house often puts contestants in situations that test their patience and ability to handle disagreements. While confrontations and differences of opinion are common on the reality show, the way contestants respond to such moments can also become a talking point.
 Gullu's measured response stood out as he refrained from exchanging personal remarks and continued to handle the situation calmly. Meanwhile, Amrapali's comment brought attention to the interaction, which could become another talking point among viewers following the contestants' journey in the house.
